name: Mars 2020 terrain relative navigation HiRISE orthomosaic of Jezero, 25 cm
licence: Public domain (NASA / USGS); credit the instrument teams named (USGS Astrogeology; Fergason et al. 2020)
notes: Read live by /api/hirise from USGS's copy on Amazon S3 (HTTP ranges, one per row; 25 cm to 8 m in six levels, 512 px tiles, cached for a year). One band (HiRISE RED): its brightness, as a ratio to its own local mean, is laid over the orbital colour, in Rover View within 2 km of the viewer and on the map from zoom 15. Not in the package.
